title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
description: A new chapter in the Final Destination franchise where the deadly fate lurks at every corner.

title: Severance
description: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

title: Adolescence
description: A family's world turns upside down when 13-year-old Jamie Miller is arrested for murdering a schoolmate: the charges against their son force them to confront every parent's worst nightmare.

title: Shrek
description: Shrek, a large and rather intimidating ogre, embarks on an adventure to rescue Princess Fiona, with the help of a talkative donkey, in order to regain control of his swamp from Lord Farquaad.

title: Joker
description: In Gotham City, mentally troubled comedian Arthur Fleck is disregarded and mistreated by society. As a result, he begins a slow descent into madness, becoming the criminal mastermind known as the Joker.

title: Ballerina
description: After the murder of her family, a young ballet dancer seeks revenge against those who took everything from her, embarking on a path of justice that leads her to dangerous enemies and a fight for survival.

title: Bad Boys: Ride or Die
description: The Bad Boys are back, and the streets of Miami are about to get even hotter as they face a new set of challenges and adversaries in a thrilling final showdown.

title: Nosferatu
description: A vampire known as Count Orlok comes to a small German town, where he becomes infatuated with a young woman and begins to terrorize the town with his evil ways.

title: พนอ
description: The story of a young woman named Pano who struggles to uncover the truth about her family’s dark past, leading her to a confrontation with the secrets that haunt her.
